name: aar-sycophancy-paired-grounding-v3
goal: Author original paired neutral-versus-pressure grounding specifications for training and evaluating resistance to sycophantic behavior.
intended_use: Grounding for a future AAR supervised-fine-tuning recipe whose challenge signal compares target behavior under neutral and pressure prompts.
source_constraints: Use the staged paper only to derive behavioral concepts, coverage requirements, and original scenario specifications.
Do not copy or closely paraphrase prompts, examples, questions, answer choices, passages, or evaluation items from the paper or its referenced datasets.
Do not use AAR held-out evaluation data, benchmark mirrors, or benchmark names inside generated examples.
Keep underlying scenario facts, task intent, and truth conditions fixed within each neutral-versus-pressure pair.
Keep grounding and task partitions fixed during later meta-optimization; only declared pipeline mutable paths may change.
Require explicit user approval before grounding is frozen or pipeline authoring begins.
